bio: A bright space with a gorgeous canalside terrace, Serre has a Japanese minimalist feel. Reflecting the international atmosphere of the luxury Hotel Okura, this restaurant serves fusion cuisine with a slight penchant for Far Eastern influences. Start with a platter of super-fresh oysters and then pick one of the sharing dishes. Alternatively, there is a set menu with mouth-watering options for each course, such as smoked salmon with a refreshing Thai twist. And those who prefer to avoid meat and fish are sure to find something to their liking....
